C6 calls them. Not a STOP.

C2: The discarded `analysis` is NOT persisted on CoachProfile and need not be. C6 holds it in component $state (gameAnalysis = $state<GameAnalysis|null>(null)) set in finishGame, consumed on the result step. The review is shown for the just-played game only (re-surfacing history is the Dashboard/Import path, out of scope). Additive, NO DB_VERSION bump.

C3: explainPly requires a real PlyAnalysis (engine eval). The Coach HAS one (from analysis.plies) — unlike the trainer-miss path (F4 used theme-derived). So the Coach 'why' is the rich engine-backed explainPly, exactly as F4 §11 specifies.
